prompt: Rendered in a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling snowy town square. In the center stands a tall stone fountain capped with ice. To the left of the fountain, a woman in a blue coat holds a steaming mug. Next to her, a child in a yellow hat reaches for a balloon held by a vendor in a striped apron. The vendor smiles while handing the string to the child. A brown dog sits on the cobblestones near the woman’s boots, looking up at her. Behind the dog, an old man in a grey flat cap leans on a wooden cane. He is looking at a newspaper held open by a young student in a green backpack. The student stands next to a lamppost wrapped in fairy lights. On the right side of the square, a couple shares a single red umbrella. The man in the black jacket has his arm around the woman in the pink scarf. They are walking past a bench where a tired worker in orange overalls is sitting. Beside the bench, a stray cat with white paws watches a pigeon pecking at crumbs. The pigeon is near the feet of a cyclist in a helmet who is stopping their bike. The cyclist is looking at a map spread on the handlebars. Further back, a baker in a white uniform points toward a shop window displaying loaves of bread. A tourist in a camera strap looks at the bakery sign. Near the edge of the frame, a street musician in a beret plays a violin. A small crowd gathers, including a girl in purple boots who is clapping. Another boy in a blue beanie stands next to her, holding a toy truck. A police officer in a dark uniform walks past them, glancing at a parked delivery van. The van has its rear doors open, revealing boxes inside. A driver in a cap leans against the van door, checking a clipboard. There is no sun visible in the sky. There is no traffic moving on the roads. There is no digital signage or screens present.
